hypothesis_queue.rejection_reason: Reducing KELLY_LOOKBACK_DAYS from 10 to 5 would create a permanent probe deadlock: during probation the bot fires 1 probe/day. In a 5-day window, max accumulation = 5 trades. But KELLY_MIN_TRADES=10 requires 10 trades to activate Kelly. Therefore Kelly would NEVER exit 'inactive' mode during probation recovery. KELLY_LOOKBACK_DAYS=10 is the minimum that allows probes to recover the Kelly window (10 probes in 10 days). Correct fixes for intraday reactivity: H24 (boundary guard) + H25 (cluster-day cap). Both already implemented and awaiting merge.

hypothesis_queue.hypothesis: Kelly window structural fragility — a single trading day's cluster of losses can dominate the 10-day fraction (Aug 31: 12 trades on one date drove fraction from -0.73 to -5.37). Two-part fix: (1) require Kelly window to span ≥5 distinct trading days before allowing full-size entries (KELLY_MIN_UNIQUE_DAYS=5); (2) cap any single trading day's contribution to the Kelly fraction (cluster-day cap). Together these prevent a one-day event from disabling the system for the full subsequent 10-day window.
